d: Customers on one package can move up to a better one, for example a weekly class pass to unlimited, for the difference in price (less for time already used). They see the offer in the app and pay it like any order; the front desk sees it on the customer. Set the upgrades in Packages.

A short checklist on Today for the manager of a new business: your look, classes, packages, first member, first sale, first check-in and your team. Each step opens the right place and ticks itself when it is done. It goes away when everything is done, or when you hide it.
Sell at the till, stock and the shop.
Menu, food orders from the app and to rooms, the kitchen screen, open and closed times.

When you sell to someone new, at the till or as a walk-in on Today, the form asks for their email and their phone with the country code (for WhatsApp), with a tick if they do not want messages or emails from you. Only the name is needed. A known email or phone finds the customer they already are, so nobody is in twice. Off: one Email or phone box.

n: Packages from a stay, for everyone in the room
d: Write how many people are in the room and their names on the stay. An Add package button on each stay sells a training package to the guest or to someone else in the room, with their own name, and it can go on the room bill with Charge to the room bill. The Sell a package form offers the room bill too when the customer is staying now.

n: Extending a paid stay opens the bill
d: When you extend a stay whose bill is already settled, the paid bill is kept as a closed part (paid up to the old leaving date) and the bill opens again, so the new nights show as owed. Off: the stay stays settled and the extra nights are not charged.

A Cancel and refund button on each stay: give back all or part of the room and any add-ons (meals, training, spa) in one go, with a manager PIN. Each amount shows in Accounts as money out on the day, in the department it was paid to, so the accounts correct themselves. If the stay was paid online, the money goes back to their card through Stripe for you.

n: Add-ons for every guest in a room
d: On the booking page guests say how many are staying. Each add-on (training, meals, spa, privates) can be for one guest or all of them, priced for each, and extras marked second guest only (like group training for the second guest) show when two are staying. The desk can do the same when adding extras to a stay. Set how many a room sleeps in Settings, Room prices.

n: Room payments to the main Stripe account
d: Card payments for stays and room invoices go to your main Stripe account, not the Thai baht one. Off: payments in baht go to the Thai baht account. Paying by Thai QR (PromptPay) always uses the Thai baht account.

Room bookings come in from the MotoPress plugin on a WordPress website, and moving or extending one changes it in MotoPress too. Off: rooms are booked in the app and on your own booking page, and changes to old MotoPress bookings are saved in the app only.
Room bookings, room bills, welcome emails and housekeeping.
Group classes, check in to classes, the timetable in the app and on the website.
Private sessions with a coach, online booking and the coach view.
No private can be booked during a group class. Off: only classes ticked "Blocks privates" block them.
On any private you can type exactly what the coach gets, for example for 2 people, instead of their usual percent.

Every new, changed or deleted stay, private, package sold, payment, room charge, customer, staff member, package and product is written down with who did it and when, and what changed (before and after). Managers see a History button on each stay, private and customer, and everything in Settings, Activity. Kept for a year.

n: Cancel or no show for privates
d: A Cancel or no show button on each private, for the front desk and managers: say what happened and why, and tick Still paid when it counts like a session (a pack session is used or the price stays owed, and the coach is paid). Not ticked, nothing is owed and a pack session comes back.

The AI reads the last 6 months of customer chats (also older Instagram, Facebook and WhatsApp chats you bring in) and learns how your team answers. You check its answers. It then writes drafts for the team to send, or sends by itself only the topics you allow. Messages, AI learning.
Ready answers anyone on the team puts in a chat with one tap (Saved, next to the message box). Save what you typed in one tap. The AI uses them too.

GetYourGuide checks what is free in the app and books straight into it: group classes by the timetable and places, privates with a free coach. Each booking is filed with the guest and sends the booking notification, without copying emails. Settings, Privates, GetYourGuide.

Each person picks what comes to their phone: privates and rooms booked, packages bought or ordered in the app, packages sold and rooms booked by the team, and every till sale. Managers can set it for anyone. Settings, Messages, Phone notifications.

n: Privates priced by people and coaches
d: A private package can have prices for more people or more coaches, for example 2 people with 1 coach. The customer picks how many when buying in the app, and the front desk when selling. Packs and bigger amounts keep their discount. Set the prices on the package.
A private can have more than one coach and more than one person. Each extra coach is blocked for that time, sees it in their app and is paid through Commission. The extra people see it in their app.
A coach can have their own private price. On a pack, the customer pays the difference as a top up.

n: Website booking extras on the stay
d: Extras a guest books with a room on your website booking plugin (breakfast, a meal plan, training, transfers) come into the app on their stay, paid with the stay. Breakfasts and meal plans can then be ticked as served and billed by the cafe.
A Watch how button on Packages, Timetable, Staff, Customers, Accounts, Stays, Web pages and Social media plays a short video of how to do it.
A coach gets a notification on their phone when a private is booked with them, moved or cancelled. The coach turns notifications on once, on their own screen in the app.
Coach shares of privates and paying them out.
Fighters, fight dates and results.
Courses people buy and learn from in the app.
Single technique videos with notes, in categories, next to the courses (Education). Each video is public (website and app), app only, for members with a package, or only inside courses.
Everyone can switch the app to Thai: staff, coaches and customers. Phones set to Thai start in Thai.
Everyone can switch the app to Myanmar (Burmese). Good for staff from Myanmar.

n: Course offer when buying a package or a room
d: One online course can be offered when someone buys a package (on the website and at the desk) or books a room on the website, with its own price and words. Set it on the course, in Courses.

When someone buys a training package on your website and it is paid, they get a welcome email by themselves: their package and start date, your class times, how to get the app and sign in, what to bring and where you are. Change the wording in Settings, Messages, Package welcome email.

When someone gets an online course (bought on the website, with a package or a stay, or given at the desk) they get an email by themselves: how to get the app and sign in, where the course is, and what opens on which day. Each course has its own wording: open the course and tap Welcome email.

A Fighters page on your website where people apply to fight for your gym: their record, weight, experience, social media and when they want to come. Applications show in Customers, Fighters, where you accept them (they become a customer marked as a fighter) or decline.

A Welcome pack button on each partner (Referrals): one email with their link, what they earn, links to your main pages, how to sign in to the app to see their bookings and earnings, and tips for using their link. Their app account is made from their email if they have none. You read it and press Send. Change the wording in Referrals, Welcome email.

Managers can sell a package as a custom deal: their own length (for example 4 months) and their own price, with Fitness Zone included if they like, starting on the first visit, today or a chosen date. In Sell a package, tick Custom deal.

The app support team can open your back office to help you, without you making them a login. They show in Staff as Tech support while they are in, and you can remove them there. Turn this off and they are taken off straight away and cannot come in.

n: Member card in Apple Wallet and Google Wallet
d: Members add their card to Apple Wallet or Google Wallet: their name, package, classes left and end date, with a QR code. The front desk scans it on the check in screen (Scan card). It updates by itself on iPhones when a package is sold or a class is used. Members who only train can use the card instead of the app. Needs the Apple pass certificate and the Google Wallet account in the server settings.

A new business starts with only the basics: check ins for members and staff in the first week. When you are happy, tap Next step and the next part comes in: selling, then accounting, messages, privates and coaches, and growing your business. The menu only shows the steps you have reached, so nothing is overwhelming. You choose when to move on, and See everything opens it all at any time. Settings, General, Getting started in steps.

One person owns the business: only they switch features, change money settings and add or change managers and admins. They keep recovery codes in case they are locked out. Set it in Settings, General, Owner.

When someone buys a private on the website, they can add extras you choose: water, hand wraps, lunch, recovery and anything else, as many as they want. Set them in Settings, Privates, Extras with privates.

A page in Thai on your website with your Local resident prices (set on each package), the timetable and how to sign up, for Thai people and residents who live nearby. The English prices page gets one line: Live here? Ask about resident memberships. Resident prices are never sold online: the desk checks ID once and sets the customer to resident prices.

An Info tab on each customer: everything you know about them in one list, newest first. When they were added and made their app account, every stay they booked and how, packages and courses with where they bought them, website orders, payments, privates, shop orders, emails sent, visits and forms. Health shows only for the people allowed to see it.

Health records (member files, health numbers, blood tests and injuries from the About you form) are seen only by the owner of the health records and the people they allow, for one member or for every member. Set who in Settings, General, Health records, and on the Info tab of each customer. Turned off, the member's coaches and the managers see them.

n: Members see who opened their file
d: In their app, members see every time someone in your team opened their member file, with the name and when. Builds trust: their health details are never looked at quietly.

Stays, privates, customers and the rest of the back office update by themselves every 2 minutes, so new bookings from the website, booking sites and agency emails, and changes other staff make, show without reloading. Never while a form is open or someone is typing.

For a business with several branches (set as centres in Settings, Website). Give each staff member their branches in Staff: they see only the customers and staff of those branches. Staff with no branch set see everything and can pick one branch or all. Customers have a home branch and one file that works at every branch.

In the member app, a course opens as Day 1, Day 2 and so on (or Lesson 1, Lesson 2 when it has no days), with every step of the day on one screen. Completed lessons stay in place, ticked, and open again any time to review. Courses stand out with their own colour, and the member's courses come first in Learn, marked Completed when finished.

When a course has lessons that open on set days, the member chooses: one lesson at a time (recommended, on the days you set) or every lesson open now. They can change it any time. A lesson that opened stays open.

Settings, General: say what you use now, see how to export your members from it, and bring them over in one upload with their current packages, so they check in from day one. Upload again any time: nobody is doubled.

n: Side by side with your old system
d: For the first month: try the app next to your old system. Members are not contacted (no welcome emails) until you tap Make this our main system, which also gives you a ready message with your app link for your members.

Ask AI can do anything the person asking can do in the app: sell packages, add packages, classes, rooms and products, bring in a whole spreadsheet, change settings and more. It works with their own rights, and nothing changes until they tap Confirm. Codes, passwords and account deletion are never offered.
A course can have a lower price for guests with a stay booked or staying now. When they buy it with the same email, the guest price is used. Set it on the course.

In the member app, a new member is asked once, after agreeing to you keeping their health details: photo, date of birth, sex, height, weight, blood type, illnesses, medication, allergies, injuries, how active they are, sleep, smoking, alcohol, how they eat, family health history, their doctor, goals and an emergency contact. Every question is optional. The answers go into their member file.

One file per member for life, in Coaching (Member file) and on the customer page: photo, alerts every coach sees, illnesses, medication, allergies, injuries, goals and emergency contact, a coaching diary with a dated entry after every session (with files, shared with the member or team only) and documents such as blood tests and letters from doctors. Only the member, their coaches and the managers see it, health details need the member to agree, and managers see who opened each file. Members see and update their own file in the app.
Programmes, check ins and messages with coaching clients.

n: Meal plans held until served, cafe meal bills
d: Money paid for a meal plan comes in as Meal plans held for the business that sold it, not as cafe sales, so it can always be refunded. The kitchen or the cafe till ticks each meal as it is served, and sends a bill for the meals served, for example once a week. A manager marks the bill paid: only then does Accounts show it as cafe sales. Meal plans bought before this was switched on stay as they were.

Meal plans, breakfast and other food plans on each customer, with the days they run. Cafe extras on room bookings and meal packages add them by themselves. The kitchen screen and Stays show who has a plan today, with their room.

Every food or drink order from the app (to a room or pay at the counter) sends a phone notification to managers, front desk, resort and kitchen staff who turned notifications on. Tapping it opens the kitchen screen.

n: Most used row on the till
d: The till shows the products sold most at that shop in the last 30 days as one row at the top, so staff find them in one tap.

Choices with their own price, asked when a product is added at the till or in the app: milk (oat +20), hot or iced, extras (add cheese +30), sweetness. Some must be chosen, some allow several. The kitchen and the receipt show them after the name.

Running tabs for tables or people: put an order on Table 1, the kitchen gets it and the till is free for the next customer. Add more to the tab any time, then bring it up at the end, print the bill and take payment. A line added in the last 10 minutes can be taken off; after that a manager uses their PIN.
A library in Coaching for PDFs, Word, Excel and PowerPoint files. Upload once, then use them in action groups and in Education lessons.

The owner can pause a member's package, for example for an injury, with a reason, who authorised it and their password. While paused it cannot be used to check in, and the days are added to the end date.

Check in shows New customer and, on every customer, Sell or book: one simple form for full name, email and phone, then a private lesson, a group class or anything else, and the payment. The coach of a private can stay empty and be added later. Agency guests keep their own button.

A Search button at the top of the menu (or Ctrl K, or the / key) finds pages, settings and features, customers by name, email or phone, staff, packages, rooms, stays and shop or menu items. Tap a result to open it.

Staff phones get a notification for every new booking that did not come from the team: a private, a room, a package bought online, or a group class guest from an agency. Choose who gets them and for what in Messages, Booking notifications. Each person turns notifications on once on their own phone.

A manager connects your Facebook page and Instagram from the app, with a Meta sign in, in Messages or Social media. Their messages come into Messages and Social media posts to them. Off: the page is connected for you by the team that runs your app.

Connect your business WhatsApp number in Messages. WhatsApp chats come into the app next to website chat, Facebook and Instagram, the desk gets a phone notice, and staff read and reply from the app. Your number can stay on the WhatsApp Business app on your phone at the same time.

An AI answers WhatsApp, Facebook and Instagram messages straight away, in the customer's language, using your prices, class times and notes from the app. It stays quiet in a chat once a staff member replies, and hands over to the team (with a phone notice) for bookings, payments, complaints and anything it does not know. Choose always, or only when the desk is away. Uses your AI allowance.
Anyone in a chat can report a message someone else wrote, with a reason if they want. Managers and the front desk get a notice that opens the chat. App stores ask for this in apps with group chats.
Groups can have customers as well as staff: fighters, people training or staying now, or anyone you pick. Can be announcements only.

n: Jobs for more than one person
d: Give a job (Pending actions) to several people at once. It shows on each of their apps and any of them can tick it off.

One page with every email the app sends: emails written in the app, invoices and receipts, welcome emails, action group emails and outreach, with what was sent, what is waiting and what failed. Write a new email from here too.
Managers pick any customer and see their app exactly as they see it: home, packages, courses and coaching. View only.

Coaching is only for the customers you turn it on for, and you choose which parts each gets: steps and habits, workouts, food diary, weight. Set it on the customer, Coaching options. Off: everyone has all of it.

A Partners page on your website where people apply to send you customers, at levels you set (for example Affiliate, Creator and Ambassador, each with its own share and perks). Applications come into Affiliates, where you approve them at a level.
People who send you customers get their own links to any page, package or course on your website, and earn a share of what is booked or bought through them.
A Receipt button on packages, privates and till sales: send the customer a receipt by email, WhatsApp, LINE or text, show a QR to scan, or copy the link. The receipt page can be saved as a PDF.

Grab, LINE MAN, foodpanda or any delivery app. Each app gets a button at the till: add the items, type the app's order number and total, and it goes to the kitchen. Accounts books the sale and the app's commission. Upload the app's statement in Accounts to match every order, book the real commission and see any order that was missed. Set the apps in Settings, Money.

A 6 digit code a manager sets in Settings, Money. On the check in screen the front desk types it to confirm what you allow: mark cash or PromptPay as paid so the person can check in, let someone check in now and pay later, and leave desk mode. After 5 wrong codes it locks for 15 minutes, and every use is listed for the manager.

n: Please pay now at check in
d: When someone checks in and owes money for a package or private, the check in screen says Please pay now with the amount and a card or QR button, and staff see them under Needs action now.

When someone pays by card, the card fee is always added on and the front desk cannot take it off or lower it. Only a manager can let a customer off the card fee. Off: anyone at the desk can untick it.
At the check in screen, someone who owes for a package or private must pay before they can check in. Off: they check in and are asked to pay. Staff can always check anyone in.
One tap scans customers, emails, staff, bookings and packages for duplicates, mess and unused things, and makes a report. You choose what to fix.
Choose the cover of a reel: pick a frame, upload a picture, or let the AI suggest covers with a short headline drawn in your colours.
Instagram posts from the app are tagged at your business location, and you can add up to 3 collaborators (a coach, a guest, a partner) so the post shows on their profile too.
Send Instagram and Facebook stories from Social media: one photo or one video that shows for 24 hours, at the time you choose.
Reels can also go to your TikTok account as a draft. Open TikTok, add a sound and the caption, and post.
Reels and trial reels can also go to your YouTube channel as Shorts, with the same caption and cover, and their own YouTube title.
Clock in and out, late and missed shifts, hours for pay.
Report a problem, give it to someone, tick it off.
Work done in each room and area, with its receipts.
All staff can photograph receipts, and the app keeps who added each one. Off: only managers and admins add them.
A 360 video plays in place of the staff photo in the app, in online booking and on the website.
All receipts for the month, checked and downloaded for the accounts.
Money in and out for each business and department, monthly bills and invoices.
Totals for investors, never customer names.
Leads, tags, who said yes to emails, and lists to download.
Emails to your customers and leads.
Plan and post to your social accounts.
Make and change pages on your website.
Visits and bookings from your website.

A manager can give any customer a new starting password from App access, also when they already use the app, for example when they are locked out at the desk. Off: customers who already use the app reset it themselves with Forgot password.

Customers can block anyone who writes to them in a chat. That person's messages are hidden from them in every chat, they get no phone notices from them, and managers and the front desk get a notice. They can unblock in their account (Blocked).

n: Hide courses in the store apps
d: In the iPhone and Android apps, customers see only the technique library in Learn, with no courses or course prices (Apple and Google want their own payment for digital courses). Courses still show on the website and in the app in a browser.

When booking a private, type the total received, the private amount (the coach share is worked out from this only) and any extras with their own amount and department, for example ice bath and sauna to the spa or a meal to the cafe. Accounts put each extra in its own department.

When a customer books a private with any free coach, in the app or on the website, the coach free at that time with the fewest privates that month (past and future) gets it, so privates are shared out evenly. A coach with their own higher private rate is only chosen when no other coach is free. Off: a free coach at random.

n: Book a private with any free coach
d: When customers book a private in the app or on the website, they start with Any free coach: they pick a day and a time, and a coach who is free then is chosen for them. They can tap Pick my coach to choose one. Off: they choose the coach first.
On Customers, the front desk sees people who signed up in the app but did not confirm their email or add their name yet, and can finish it for them with one tap.

An assistant in the app for the owner, and for the staff the owner ticks Ask AI on (Staff, Edit). Ask about anything in the business, send PDFs, photos or spreadsheets (for example a delivery note to add to shop stock), or ask it to write and send an email. It reads with the person's own rights, and every change is shown first and only done when they tap Confirm.

Ask AI can read your business inbox and help you answer: ask what came in today, what needs a reply, or to answer someone. New inbox emails are copied into the app every 5 minutes by the Gmail script (Settings, Booking emails, Set up Gmail) and kept for 90 days. Only the owner and admins can ask about them, and every answer is sent only after you confirm.

n: Ask AI can search the web
d: Ask AI can look things up on the internet, for example nearby hotels and their contact emails, prices or opening hours, and say where it found them. Web searches cost a little extra on the AI bill.

n: Sell or give a course at the desk
d: An Add a course button on each customer: sell one of your online courses like a package (cash, card, transfer, agent or pay later), or give it free with a reason (managers, with Give packages free of charge on). It opens in their app, in Learn, as soon as it is paid.

n: Exercise videos and opening times in action groups
d: In an action group, add videos from your exercise library (Add exercise videos, or From my exercises on a video step), and give any step a time of day, so it opens for each person at that time on its day after they join, for example Day 3 at 18:00.

Under Sales today on the Today screen: all the money taken today, from the till and every payment for packages, privates and rooms, including balances paid today for things bought earlier, split by payment type.

When selling a package, managers and admins can choose Free of charge and a reason: promotional, sponsored, staff or team, gift or apology, competition prize or other. It works like a paid package, shows as 0 THB so it is not counted as money taken, and the reason is saved on it.

n: Extras when booking a stay at the desk
d: When the team adds a stay, or on any stay, they can add the booking page extras (meal plans, transport, training, recovery and more) at the same prices. They go on the bill as not paid yet, and meal plans start the guest's food plan.

Confirmation and cancellation emails from agencies and booking sites are read into the app by the AI: group class guests show on Today with Arrived and No show, privates go to a free coach (or wait for one), and room guests get their name, email and phone on the stay from the booking site. Set it up in Settings, General, Booking emails.

A simple website for your shop with Book, Prices and About. Customers pick a treatment, a day, who and a free time, and the booking lands on your board. Treatments, prices and team come from the app. Set the texts in Settings, Website.

For a business with several centres: each centre gets its own page on your website at its own address (for example /phuket), listed on the main page. Name, photo, story, what is there, booking, contact and map come from Settings, Website. A centre can show live prices, class times and coaches from the business that runs it. Planned centres collect emails from people who want to hear when they open.

A fast two page website made from the app: Home (about, timetable, coaches, how to find you) and Prices (memberships with Join online, and a free trial request). The timetable, prices and coaches update by themselves. Set the words, photos and contact details in Settings, Website, Your gym website.

n: Free trial requests on your website
d: People ask for a free trial class on your gym website. They are added to Customers with the tag Free trial and the class they picked, so you can confirm with them.

An aerial photo of your gym with each area marked (ring, bag zone, fitness, recovery and so on). Visitors tap an area to see its photos, and a 360 view when you add one. Set it in Settings, Website, Gym tour.
The team on your website comes from Staff: photo, video, title and text.
